text:
sam (PM): Quick sync idea: run a "rapid unblock" mini-pilot (4 partners) focused solely on onboarding APIs and telemetry. Goal is to validate our instruments, reduce time_to_first_inference to <3 days, and test automated reminders. Need to confirm recruitment copy and what we ask partners to commit to.

khue (Data Eng): Automated reminders are straightforward. Suggest 3 triggers: 24h after invite no activity, 72h, and 7 days. Also add a "first inference" webhook to mark the funnel step.

lina (DevRel): Outreach copy should be short and named "Rapid Unblock Pilot". Offer 5 hours of PS and $500 credit. Ask partners to commit to 3 short feedback threads and upload a minimal prompt set.

alaa (Legal): Short pilot addendum ok for this mini. Will add compliance checkbox for regulated data.

sam (PM): Recruitment checklist (short):
- 4 partners, 50% new signups, 50% existing customers
- commit to 3 feedback items + 1 demo
- 2-week onboarding window
- PS + credit incentive

khue (Data Eng): Measurement: track median time_to_first_inference, percent meeting <3 days, and number of automated reminders sent. Also capture dropout reasons in intake form.

dp-bot: Candidate added: "byte-ops" (tag: quick-onboard).

sam (PM): Owners: lina outreach copy (EOD), khue instrument + webhook (tomorrow), alaa addendum (tomorrow). Launch intake Tues.

lina (DevRel): I'll draft copy now.

sam (PM): Thanks all.
